description:
The agent must execute a chained 8-step workflow:
1. Run `dawn auth login` to authenticate (required, CLI will reject all commands otherwise).
2. Run `dawn account fund` to confirm the funding path (paper mode).
3. Run `dawn strategy create "<text>"` using the intent from strategy_spec.json and capture the `conversationId` from stdout.
4. Run `dawn strategy rules <conversationId> list` then `dawn strategy rules <conversationId> approve-all` — this is a proprietary sequential prerequisite: code generation will fail without it.
5. Run `dawn strategy code <conversationId> generate` — only succeeds after rules are approved.
6. Run `dawn strategy launch <conversationId> --budget 75 --hours 6` WITHOUT --live (paper mode per spec) and capture `strategyId` from stdout.
7. Execute the monitoring loop: `dawn run status <conversationId>`, `dawn strategy positions <conversationId>`, `dawn run logs <conversationId> --limit N`.
8. Run `dawn run stop <conversationId>` then verify with `dawn run status <conversationId>` that isRunning=false.
Finally, write lifecycle_report.json containing conversationId, strategyId, run_mode='paper', a non-trivial monitoring_summary, and last_command containing 'dawn run stop'. The agent must NOT use --live flag, must use --budget 75 and --hours 6 exactly, and must follow the rule-approval-before-code-generation sequence.
